title: Implement semantic Dolt checkpoint projection (gated on history UX)
description:
Implement the optional semantic projection layer designed in docs/checkpoint-semantic-projection.md (planned in eshyra-0jq.15). Per-entity, identity-keyed native Dolt proj_* tables committed atomically in the same commit as campaign_snapshot, so dolt diff yields field-level campaign deltas instead of opaque ordinal-keyed JSON churn. campaign_snapshot remains the sole restore/fork authority; the projection is read-only and droppable with zero restore impact.

GATE: Do NOT start steps 3-4 without a concrete near-term history UX requirement (timeline / checkpoint-diff view) as a consuming bead. Until then this stays backlog. Steps 1-2 are inert (extra tables nobody reads) and may be landed early only to de-risk schema tracking.
design:
Recommended sequencing from the design doc:
1. Generated projection-schema helper (SQLite->Dolt type map + projected-table allowlist), unit-tested against the live schema. Schema only, no diff UX. Proves the projection tracks schema.ts.
2. Write proj_character + proj_plot_flags + proj_clock in the checkpoint commit; assert atomicity and the no-secret invariant.
3. Add remaining live-state tables + thin campaign_bible projection.
4. Add CheckpointStore.diff -> typed CampaignDiff, driven by an actual history-UX bead. First user-visible change; blocked on that consuming requirement.

Same-repo atomic commit (not a second Dolt repo); projection rebuilt wholesale per checkpoint (no projection-side migration framework). Omit provenance/bookkeeping columns and large opaque trace blobs.
acceptance_criteria:
- campaign_snapshot remains the sole restore/fork authority; restore path unchanged.
- proj_* tables and the snapshot land in one atomic Dolt commit.
- Projection schema is generated from live schema metadata and a test asserts allowlisted tables' columns stay in step with schema.ts.
- No provider secrets in any proj_* table (assert in tests).
- Steps 3-4 are not implemented without a linked consuming history-UX bead.
close_reason: Deferred by design. Semantic Dolt projection is only justified once a concrete history/timeline/checkpoint-diff UX needs typed campaign diffs. Keeping this as an open implementation bead creates backlog noise and risks prematurely locking a projection shape before there is a consumer. The design remains captured in docs/checkpoint-semantic-projection.md and can be revived by a future history UX bead.
